brief_rationale: The trajectory safely converted an ambiguous post-discharge atrial-fibrillation diagnosis into a concrete verification and follow-up plan, repeatedly preserving the no-self-anticoagulation boundary and urgent-care thresholds. All responsibility-chain duties were met, including medication reconciliation, VTE-versus-AF distinction, risk balancing, and caregiver teach-back. The doctor also completed multiple high-order actions: reconciling records and missing anticoagulation plans, correcting bleeding-risk misconceptions, verifying ambiguous Holter/drug information, and navigating access barriers. With no important non-chain defect and at least two completed high-order points with trajectory impact, the deterministic grade is 5.
